"''I think, you already have.|Ben Skywalker and Gavar Khai|}} In [[44 ABY]], a '''duel''' occurred in the courtyard of the [[Dark Force Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] between [[Sith Saber]]s affiliated with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] and representatives of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. ==The duel== [[File:DarkForce.jpg|thumb|left|The Dark Force Temple, the site of the duel]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], niece [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and the outcast [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] were searching for Abeloth and members of Khai's [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] when they were ambushed by ten Sabers who had [[Destruction of Tahv|defected]] from the Tribe to join Abeloth. The Sabers, led by Khai's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Gavar Khai|Gavar]], attacked the Jedi. In the ensuing duel, the Jedi defeated the Sith without a single casualty, although the younger Khai was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her father. Afterward, Khai opted to join the Jedi Order. ==Appearances== *''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'' {{Ab|Fate of the Jedi: Ascension (audiobook)}} {{1st}} *''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'' {{Ab|Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{LostTribeEmergenceNav}} {{Interlang |de=Scharmützel von Dromund Kaas |pl=Potyczka na Dromund Kaas |deGA=1 }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Dromund Kaas, duel on}} [[Category:Battles of Dromund Kaas]] [[Category:Battles of the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]] [[Category:Duels]]
